calls.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL game-ready animated sprite atlas for -SEED, a dark science-fantasy civilization survivor. One Resonant hero: imposing upright armored human scholar-warrior, obsidian blue segmented armor, ivory and antique brass trims, luminous cyan crystal staff, short split cape, strong readable broad shoulder silhouette, beautiful premium hand-painted 2D game illustration with crisp dark outlines and clean material highlights, never generic flat geometric vector. Three-quarter overhead game camera, full body, upright feet bottom; NO camera perspective changes. Transparent background, no scenery, no letters, no numbers, no grid lines, no drop shadows beyond compact feet shadow. Technical: EXACT 4 by 4 evenly spaced atlas on a square canvas, 16 equal square cells. Every sprite entirely inside its cell with 12% margin and feet aligned at 85% cell height. All frames same body size and same equipment, no cropped weapon. Row 1 front-facing: idle, left stride, right stride, staff attack extended. Row 2 front-facing: hurt recoil, dash leaning forward cape trailing, death fallen on ground, special ability staff raised. Row 3 back-facing: idle, left stride, right stride, staff attack extended. Row 4 back-facing: hurt recoil, dash cape trailing, death fallen, special ability staff raised. Walk frames must actually change legs/arms; attack silhouette different; death must actually be fallen. Beautiful integrated animation artwork, not a concept poster. No art or characters from existing games. Overall output 2048x2048 if available. This atlas will be sliced into 16 cells.

Create a game-ready Hunters hero atlas as a coherent sibling of this reference Resonant atlas. Preserve exactly 4 columns x 4 rows and exactly the same 16 pose roles and front/back viewpoints, same premium hand-painted game style. Replace subject with fierce civilization ranger in bone-white angular armor over charcoal leather, copper hunting mask, short red-brown split cape, a long original brass projectile rifle instead of any magical staff. Dominant orange/amber accents, no cyan magical rings. Clear broad combat silhouette. Rows: front idle/left stride/right stride/rifle aimed firing; front hurt/dash/death fallen/special aimed salvo; back idle/left stride/right stride/rifle firing; back hurt/dash/death fallen/special salvo. Each sprite fully inside its equal square cell with 12% EMPTY TRANSPARENT MARGIN ON ALL FOUR SIDES. Do not touch outer canvas edges. Feet same baseline, consistent scale. Transparent actual alpha, no text/grid/scenery. Attack is actual rifle attack, not staff casting. No copied characters. This is one atlas asset to slice and integrate into gameplay.

ONE sprite atlas; not a concept poster.

Distinguished massive pearl-white and steel knight in dark navy underarmor, broad shield silhouette, tall angular helm, blue-violet power core, large polygon shield held on left arm, short heavy sword in right hand, short violet cloak. Row1 front idle, left walk, right walk, sword slash; row2 front hurt recoil, dash shield forward, death fallen, special shield raised; row3 back idle,left walk,right walk,sword slash; row4 back hurt,dash,death fallen,special shield raised. Beautiful recognizable shield guardian hero; ONE atlas for gameplay import.

Create ONE ORIGINAL seamless square top-down ground texture tile for a premium hand-painted 2D dark science-fantasy survivor game. Verdant lost-civilization woodland FLOOR, not a landscape illustration. Pure orthographic overhead, no horizon. Dark muted forest green moss, fine fern clusters and low grass tufts, earthy umber worn patches, small weathered slate fragments, a few broken flat ancient masonry slabs with faint teal mineral veins. Rich natural tactile painterly material detail, carefully composed understated density, no huge shapes, no repetitive geometric circles or sharp grid. Entire surface is WALKABLE decoration. No standing trees, no tall rocks, no walls, no buildings, no characters, no text, no shadows suggesting obstacles. Keep middle value DARK and contrast low so cyan/amber hero and red warning attacks stand out. Organic varied floor surface with readable texture at512px gameplay scale. PERFECTLY SEAMLESS opposite edges for repeated square tiling, no edge vignette or border. Full opaque image, square texture intended as actual repeating game terrain, NOT concept art or a mockup. Original unique artwork.
